slides.title: An unanswered WhatsApp is a *lost sale.*
slides.sub: Ads bring the message. Speed closes it.

caption:
You paid for the ad. The customer clicked. They sent a WhatsApp message asking for the price.

Then nobody replied for six hours.

By then they've bought from someone else. Fast replies often matter more than a bigger ad budget.

Set up WhatsApp Business quick replies and a greeting message today. It's free and takes ten minutes.

How fast does your business usually reply? Be honest in the comments.
